promises.encrypted: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest.
promises.approval: Nothing important happens without your approval.
promises.ads: Your data is never sold for advertising.
promises.training: Email content is never used to train models.
promises.trainingLong: Your email content is never used to train AI models.
promises.deletable: You can delete your data at any time.

storage.canonical: The full content of your emails isn't stored; only summaries, short quotes and analysis results are kept for your retention period.
storage.firstAnalysisFooter: The last 72 hours were analysed. The full content of your emails isn't stored.
storage.androidNi: Notification content is processed on your device; only the extracted details (for example shipment status, amount, date) are saved to your account. Verification codes and security apps are always excluded.
storage.crossBorder: AI analysis runs at our sub-processors in the United States.

aiData.title: What can the AI access?
aiData.subtitle: As of today. You can turn off any row; what you turn off isn't analysed.

mailBody.title: Email subjects and bodies
mailBody.meta: For summaries · Full email content isn't stored

contacts.title: Contacts
contacts.meta: Only name matching and people summaries

aiData.footnote: Even if these appear in an email, they're removed before anything is sent to the AI, and they're never stored.

mail_body.title: Turn off email bodies?
mail_body.body: If you turn this off, the AI uses only the sender and subject line. Email summaries, key points and reply drafts won't work, and priorities will be less accurate.

attachments.title: Turn off attachments?
attachments.body: Bill, proposal and ticket attachments won't be read, so dates and amounts in them won't be picked up.

calendar.title: Turn off calendar details?
calendar.body: Meeting prep will use only the title and time; attendees and locations won't be shown.

contacts.title: Turn off contacts?
contacts.body: People pages and relationship summaries won't be prepared. Your VIPs and priority rules keep working by email address.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.subtitle: How long should analysis results and summaries be kept?
retention.explanation: Memory search is limited to this period. Your original emails stay in your own account.

shorten.title: Shorten retention to {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}?
shorten.body: {count, plural, one {# summary, priority decision or memory entry} other {# summaries, priority decisions and memory entries}} older than {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} will be permanently deleted at the next clean-up (within 24 hours).

history.title: Analysis history
history.body: Summaries, priority decisions, AI memory and learned preferences are deleted. Your emails and calendar aren't affected.
history.willDelete: To be deleted: {summaries, plural, one {# summary} other {# summaries}} · {decisions, plural, one {# priority decision} other {# priority decisions}} · {memory, plural, one {# memory entry} other {# memory entries}} · {preferences, plural, one {# learned preference} other {# learned preferences}}
history.willKeep: Kept: connections, settings, your priority rules, your VIP list, open commitments and scheduled reminders
history.processing: Deleting… This can take a few minutes.
history.completedCount: {count, plural, one {# summary deleted} other {# summaries deleted}}
history.failed: Deletion couldn't be completed. You can try again.

confirm.title: Delete your analysis history?
confirm.body: Summaries, priority decisions and the memory index from the last {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} are deleted. Your emails and calendar aren't affected. This can't be undone.
confirm.bodyAll: All summaries, priority decisions and the memory index are deleted. Your emails and calendar aren't affected. This can't be undone.

export.title: Export my data
export.body: We'll prepare a copy of your account data as JSON files in a ZIP. Access keys and passwords aren't included.
export.contents: Profile and settings · Connected account details (without keys) · Summaries and briefings · Commitments, reminders and approvals · Assistant conversations · Files you uploaded
export.processingNotify: Preparing… We'll send a notification when it's ready.
